answer.text: 1 + per-period YTM (YTM adjusted to coupon-payment frequency)

explanation.text: The Logic: Modified Duration = Macaulay's Duration ÷ (1 + YTM adjusted to coupon-payment frequency). For non-annual coupon bonds the YTM in the denominator must be expressed per coupon period, not as the annual yield. The Trap: Using just '1 + annual yield' is incomplete when coupons are paid semi-annually or quarterly. Dividing by maturity, by 2, or by (maturity − 1) are unrelated to the duration formula. Note: The workbook's worked calculation uses a frequency-adjusted denominator consistent with this definition.
